trips.title: Chennai to Ooty and Nilgiri Hills 3-Day Journey

versions.change_summary: Resolved airport availability: Ooty has no commercial airport. Configured real-time flight via Coimbatore International Airport (CJB) with scenic hill cab transfer (88 km), plus direct Nilgiri Superfast & Toy Train railway options.

days.title: Arrival & Welcome to Ooty and Nilgiri Hills

items.title: Flight & Hill Transit: IndiGo 6E-6565 (Chennai MAA → Coimbatore CJB) + Nilgiri Hill Taxi to Ooty
items.description: IndiGo 6E-6565 flight from Chennai (MAA) to Coimbatore (CJB) followed by scenic 88 km private hill cab climb via Mettupalayam & Coonoor Ghat Road directly into Ooty. Note: Ooty has no commercial airport; Coimbatore (CJB) is the nearest operational airport.
items.location: Chennai International Airport (MAA) → Coimbatore Airport (CJB) & Ooty
items.why_recommended: Fastest multi-modal route: Non-stop flight to Coimbatore (CJB) followed by scenic mountain road transfer to Ooty.

source.source_name: IndiGo Live Flight Schedules (MAA-CJB) & Nilgiri Mountain Cab Mobility Hub

items.title: Hotel Check-in: Fortune Resort Sullivan Court, Ooty
items.description: Check-in, welcome Nilgiri tea, unpack and settle into hillside suites overlooking Nilgiri slopes.
items.why_recommended: Strategically situated 1.2km from primary attractions with colonial fireplace suites and panoramic mountain views.

items.title: Government Botanical Garden, Ooty
items.description: Sprawling 55-acre terraced garden established in 1848 featuring over 650 species of exotic flora, a 20-million-year-old fossil tree trunk, and Italian ornamental lawns.
items.why_recommended: Aligns with your interest in Nature & Heritage. Rated 4.6★.

source.source_name: Tamil Nadu Horticulture & Google Places Live

items.title: Ooty Lake & Boathouse
items.description: Picturesque 65-acre artificial lake framed by eucalyptus groves, offering motor, row, and pedal boat cruises, lakeside horseback rides, and cycling tracks.
items.why_recommended: Aligns with your interest in Boating & Leisure. Rated 4.4★.

days.title: Exploring Ooty & Nilgiri Mountain Peaks
days.theme: Mountain Vistas, Tea Estates & UNESCO Toy Train

items.title: Doddabetta Peak & Telescope Observatory
items.description: Highest peak in the Nilgiri Mountains at 2,637 meters (8,650 ft), offering 360-degree panoramic vistas across misty pine valleys through dual telescopes.
items.why_recommended: Highest point in Tamil Nadu with breathtaking panoramic ridge views. Rated 4.5★.

items.title: Highfield Tea Estate & Traditional Chocolate Factory
items.description: Working 50-year-old orthodox tea plantation and artisanal chocolate kitchen offering live CTC tea processing tours, fresh cardamom tea sampling, and handcrafted Nilgiri fudge.
items.why_recommended: Authentic Nilgiri tea tasting and live chocolate making experience. Rated 4.5★.

source.source_name: Tea Board of India & Google Places

items.title: Nilgiri Mountain Railway (Toy Train Ride Experience)
items.description: UNESCO World Heritage mountain rack railway built in 1908, chugging through steep forested ravines, 16 tunnels, and 250 viaduct bridges across Nilgiri valleys.
items.why_recommended: World-renowned UNESCO Heritage railway experience through Nilgiri hills. Rated 4.8★.

source.source_name: Southern Railway / IRCTC Heritage Rail Division

items.title: Government Rose Garden, Elk Hill
items.description: One of the largest rose gardens in India terraced across 10 acres, showcasing over 20,000 varieties of roses including rare miniature, hybrid tea, and green roses.
items.why_recommended: Stunning floral displays and tranquil walking paths on Elk Hill. Rated 4.6★.

days.title: Pykara Waterfalls & Scenic Mountain Descent
days.theme: Cascading Waterfalls & Coimbatore Gateway Homeward Transit

items.title: Pykara Lake & Cascading Waterfalls
items.description: Sacred Toda river cascading into two majestic tiered waterfalls before opening into a serene lake surrounded by shola grasslands, featuring thrilling speed boat rides.
items.why_recommended: Pristine pine-fringed lake and cascading waterfall rapids. Rated 4.7★.

items.title: Commercial Road Artisanal Market & Charing Cross
items.description: Vibrant market hub for procuring authentic Nilgiri winter oils (eucalyptus), homemade hill fudge chocolates, Toda embroidery stoles, and orthodox black teas.
items.why_recommended: Top destination for authentic Nilgiri souvenirs and local artisan products.

items.title: Scenic Mountain Descent & Return Flight to Chennai
items.description: Scenic Nilgiri mountain cab descent from Ooty via Coonoor Ghats (88 km, ~2.5h) to Coimbatore International Airport (CJB) for scheduled return flight to Chennai (MAA).
items.why_recommended: Return journey scheduled on IndiGo 6E-6565 via Coimbatore International Airport gateway.
